units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|name|118|0
units.english: Search <planet>
units.italian: Cerca <planet>

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|description|119|0
units.english: Following information from Myurej's contact, look for Riiria at <destination>.
units.italian: Seguendo le informazioni del contatto di Casa Myurej, cerca Riiria su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|You enter <planet>'s vast spaceport to find it almost deserted. There is, however, plenty of evidence to support your contact's suggestion. A number of empty but recently-opened cargo containers are strewn against one of the far walls of the space; beside one of them there's even a small cache of what looks like personal gear: a durable fabric pack, a small sidearm, even some packages of dried food. Someone must have left here in a hurry.|126|0
units.english: You enter <planet>'s vast spaceport to find it almost deserted. There is, however, plenty of evidence to support your contact's suggestion. A number of empty but recently-opened cargo containers are strewn against one of the far walls of the space; beside one of them there's even a small cache of what looks like personal gear: a durable fabric pack, a small sidearm, even some packages of dried food. Someone must have left here in a hurry.
units.italian: Entri nello sterminato spazioporto di <planet> e lo trovi quasi deserto. Ci sono però abbondanti prove a sostegno del suggerimento del tuo contatto. Diversi container di carico vuoti, aperti di recente, sono sparsi contro una delle pareti in fondo; accanto a uno di essi c'è persino una piccola scorta di quello che sembra equipaggiamento personale: uno zaino di tessuto resistente, una piccola arma da fianco, perfino alcuni pacchetti di cibo essiccato. Qualcuno se n'è andato di qui in fretta.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|	(Rummage through the pack.)|128|0
units.english: (Rummage through the pack.)
units.italian: (Fruga nello zaino.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|	(Prepare to leave.)|129|0
units.english: (Prepare to leave.)
units.italian: (Preparati a partire.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|	Inside you find, among the odds and ends of this Successor's belongings, a still-warm data-sphere. It springs to life as you touch it, relaying its most recent message:|133|0
units.english: Inside you find, among the odds and ends of this Successor's belongings, a still-warm data-sphere. It springs to life as you touch it, relaying its most recent message:
units.italian: Dentro, tra le cianfrusaglie degli averi di questo Successore, trovi una sfera di dati ancora calda. Si risveglia appena la tocchi e trasmette il suo messaggio più recente:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|	"Riiria says the Houses shan't find us here, that they see these wretched hulks as icons'f their folly they daren't touch. They're right, I know, and yet I shudder most at thinking of that alien the Houses're so fond'f using. Riiria says fools're much more fearsome than the wise."|134|0
units.english: "Riiria says the Houses shan't find us here, that they see these wretched hulks as icons'f their folly they daren't touch. They're right, I know, and yet I shudder most at thinking of that alien the Houses're so fond'f using. Riiria says fools're much more fearsome than the wise."
units.italian: "Riiria dice che le Casate non ci troveranno qui, che vedono questi miserabili relitti come icone della propria follia e non osano toccarli. Ha ragione, lo so, eppure rabbrividisco soprattutto al pensiero di quello straniero che le Casate sono così felici di usare. Riiria dice che gli stolti sono molto più temibili dei saggi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|	The message ends there, and you can't quite figure out how to access the rest of the data on the sphere, so you leave it be.|135|0
units.english: The message ends there, and you can't quite figure out how to access the rest of the data on the sphere, so you leave it be.
units.italian: Il messaggio finisce lì, e non riesci a capire come accedere al resto dei dati della sfera, così la lasci stare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 2|	If Riiria isn't at this station, they might be at the other one to the south, so you head back to your ship and enter the coordinates on your map.|137|0
units.english: If Riiria isn't at this station, they might be at the other one to the south, so you head back to your ship and enter the coordinates on your map.
units.italian: Se Riiria non è in questa stazione, potrebbe essere nell'altra, a sud; torni quindi alla tua nave e inserisci le coordinate sulla mappa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|name|141|0
units.english: Continue the search
units.italian: Continua la ricerca

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|description|142|0
units.english: Having not found Riiria at <origin>, look for them at <destination>.
units.italian: Non avendo trovato Riiria su <origin>, cercala su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|Not longer after you guide the <ship> through this station's docking aperture, you see parked on one of the disused landing pads a clearly unpowered Successor freighter. It's in poor condition; much of the hull armor has been removed and a hole has been bored down through the top right over the generator bay.|149|0
units.english: Not longer after you guide the <ship> through this station's docking aperture, you see parked on one of the disused landing pads a clearly unpowered Successor freighter. It's in poor condition; much of the hull armor has been removed and a hole has been bored down through the top right over the generator bay.
units.italian: Poco dopo aver guidato la <ship> attraverso l'apertura di attracco della stazione, vedi parcheggiata su una delle piazzole in disuso una nave cargo dei Successori chiaramente priva di alimentazione. È in pessime condizioni: gran parte della corazzatura dello scafo è stata rimossa e un foro è stato praticato dall'alto, proprio sopra il vano del generatore.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	Fortunately, your ship's scanners are still able to identify its identification number, and you scramble for House Myurej's data-sphere to check it against the data Myurej provided you. This is the ship you were sent to find, you determine.|150|0
units.english: Fortunately, your ship's scanners are still able to identify its identification number, and you scramble for House Myurej's data-sphere to check it against the data Myurej provided you. This is the ship you were sent to find, you determine.
units.italian: Per fortuna gli scanner della tua nave riescono ancora a leggerne il numero di identificazione, e tu cerchi in fretta la sfera di dati di Casa Myurej per confrontarlo con i dati che Myurej ti ha fornito. È la nave che ti hanno mandato a cercare, concludi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	(Use your cargo scanner to identify its cargo.)|152|0
units.english: (Use your cargo scanner to identify its cargo.)
units.italian: (Usa lo scanner di carico per identificarne il carico.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	(Check its cargo yourself.)|155|0
units.english: (Check its cargo yourself.)
units.italian: (Controlla tu stesso il suo carico.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	Unsurprisingly, the ship's cargo bays have been picked clean and whatever wedding gifts you have been sent to retrieve aren't here. The scanner is able to interface with an unshielded, barely-powered terminal inside the hulk, however, and relays to you the ship's most recent cargo manifest:|157|0
units.english: Unsurprisingly, the ship's cargo bays have been picked clean and whatever wedding gifts you have been sent to retrieve aren't here. The scanner is able to interface with an unshielded, barely-powered terminal inside the hulk, however, and relays to you the ship's most recent cargo manifest:
units.italian: Come prevedibile, le stive della nave sono state ripulite e i regali di nozze che ti hanno mandato a recuperare non sono qui. Lo scanner riesce però a interfacciarsi con un terminale non protetto e quasi senza alimentazione dentro il relitto, e ti trasmette il manifesto di carico più recente della nave:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	You disembark the <ship> and walk into the ripped-open cargo bay of the Ojde to confirm what already seems likely: every trace of the ship's cargo has been removed. You are able to access an independently-powered terminal inside the bay, however, and as it burbles to life, it shows you the ship's most recent cargo manifest:|161|0
units.english: You disembark the <ship> and walk into the ripped-open cargo bay of the Ojde to confirm what already seems likely: every trace of the ship's cargo has been removed. You are able to access an independently-powered terminal inside the bay, however, and as it burbles to life, it shows you the ship's most recent cargo manifest:
units.italian: Scendi dalla <ship> e cammini nella stiva squarciata dell'Ojde per confermare quello che già sembra probabile: ogni traccia del carico della nave è stata rimossa. Riesci però ad accedere a un terminale con alimentazione autonoma dentro la stiva e, mentre borbotta accendendosi, ti mostra il manifesto di carico più recente della nave:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|		37 tons assorted gifts (common)|164|0
units.english: 37 tons assorted gifts (common)
units.italian: 37 tonnellate di regali vari (comuni)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|		4 tons red gold jewelry|165|0
units.english: 4 tons red gold jewelry
units.italian: 4 tonnellate di gioielli in oro rosso

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|		9 tons programmed water (for Council pools)|166|0
units.english: 9 tons programmed water (for Council pools)
units.italian: 9 tonnellate di acqua programmata (per le vasche del Consiglio)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|		3 tons ceremonial weapons|167|0
units.english: 3 tons ceremonial weapons
units.italian: 3 tonnellate di armi cerimoniali

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|		9 tons rare animals (in stasis, require constant power supply)|168|0
units.english: 9 tons rare animals (in stasis, require constant power supply)
units.italian: 9 tonnellate di animali rari (in stasi, richiedono alimentazione costante)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|		16 tons high-pressure lux filters (require pressurized environment)|169|0
units.english: 16 tons high-pressure lux filters (require pressurized environment)
units.italian: 16 tonnellate di filtri di lusso ad alta pressione (richiedono ambiente pressurizzato)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	Though most of the items don't tell you much, the last one seems like it could be a clue, and you press the terminal for details:|171|0
units.english: Though most of the items don't tell you much, the last one seems like it could be a clue, and you press the terminal for details:
units.italian: Sebbene la maggior parte delle voci non ti dica granché, l'ultima sembra poter essere un indizio, e premi sul terminale per avere dettagli:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	"House-built luxury filter units designed for undersea oxygen extraction and programming. Disperses mood-lightening particles with variable concentration. Must be kept in high-pressure environment to avoid damage. 8 million credits per unit."|172|0
units.english: "House-built luxury filter units designed for undersea oxygen extraction and programming. Disperses mood-lightening particles with variable concentration. Must be kept in high-pressure environment to avoid damage. 8 million credits per unit."
units.italian: "Unità filtranti di lusso costruite dalle Casate, progettate per l'estrazione e la programmazione dell'ossigeno in ambiente subacqueo. Disperdono particelle che alleggeriscono l'umore a concentrazione variabile. Da tenere in ambiente ad alta pressione per evitare danni. 8 milioni di crediti per unità."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	As you disconnect from the terminal, you think about any planets nearby that might fit the storage requirements of these filters, but nothing comes to mind. It looks like you'll have to check the nearby worlds manually.|175|0
units.english: As you disconnect from the terminal, you think about any planets nearby that might fit the storage requirements of these filters, but nothing comes to mind. It looks like you'll have to check the nearby worlds manually.
units.italian: Mentre ti scolleghi dal terminale, pensi ai pianeti vicini che potrebbero soddisfare i requisiti di stoccaggio di questi filtri, ma non te ne viene in mente nessuno. A quanto pare dovrai controllare i mondi vicini uno per uno.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3|	As you disconnect from the terminal, you think about any planets nearby that might fit the storage requirements of these filters, and one springs to mind: Maspa-Viir-Kella, an uninhabited world in the Osolaa-Uuoru system to the north. Landing there before was a challenge on account of the dense atmosphere; if the elusive Riiria is storing their spoils somewhere, that would be a good place for it.|178|0
units.english: As you disconnect from the terminal, you think about any planets nearby that might fit the storage requirements of these filters, and one springs to mind: Maspa-Viir-Kella, an uninhabited world in the Osolaa-Uuoru system to the north. Landing there before was a challenge on account of the dense atmosphere; if the elusive Riiria is storing their spoils somewhere, that would be a good place for it.
units.italian: Mentre ti scolleghi dal terminale, pensi ai pianeti vicini che potrebbero soddisfare i requisiti di stoccaggio di questi filtri, e uno ti viene in mente: Maspa-Viir-Kella, un mondo disabitato nel sistema di Osolaa-Uuoru, a nord. Atterrarvi in passato era difficile a causa dell'atmosfera densa; se l'inafferrabile Riiria nasconde il bottino da qualche parte, quello sarebbe un buon posto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3 Direct|name|184|0
units.english: Track down Riiria
units.italian: Rintraccia Riiria

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3 Direct|description|185|0
units.english: Based on the clues gathered at <origin>, go to confront Riiria at <destination>.
units.italian: In base agli indizi raccolti su <origin>, vai ad affrontare Riiria su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3 Checking|name|196|0
units.english: Track down Riiria
units.italian: Rintraccia Riiria

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 3 Checking|description|197|0
units.english: The clues you gathered at <origin> indicate that Riiria is likely hiding out on a planet in western Successor space.
units.italian: Gli indizi raccolti su <origin> indicano che Riiria si nasconde probabilmente su un pianeta dello spazio occidentale dei Successori.
